AUTHOR: Marini
TITLE: Tracking Fish Abundance by Underwater Image Recognition
REGION: OBSEA cabled observatory, 20 m depth, Vilanova i la Geltru, Catalonia, NW Mediterranean (Spain)
SPECIES: All fish (binary fish / non-fish RoI classifier, no species discrimination)
DATA: Own OBSEA observatory still images, 30-min interval, 2012 (train/validation) and 2013 (test)
V_EV: Methods: 'The scores that we used to describe the level of water turbidity varies from 0 to 3'; Fig. 5 correlation 'as a function of the level of water turbidity'
D2: Train/validation: 10% random sample of 2012 images (1,191 images; 10-fold CV on RoIs); test: 10,961 images from 2013
D_EV: Results: 'randomly sampling a subset of images that were acquired in the year 2012' ... 'The learnt image classifier was then tested on images that were acquired in the year 2013'
R_EV: Results: 'The learnt image classifier was then tested on images that were acquired in the year 2013, where 10,961 images were manually scored'
C_EV: no statement found (binary GP classifier 'returned output assumes a value 1 if the RoI contains at least a fish and is 0 otherwise'; no confidence threshold, calibration or uncertainty reported)
E_EV: Methods: 'the effectiveness of the binary classifier was estimated by computing the Pearson correlation between the time series resulting from the visual inspection and'
ARCH: Image differencing segmentation + handcrafted texture/shape features + genetic-programming binary RoI classifier (not deep learning)
METR: Validation ACC/TPR/FPR (10-fold CV); Pearson r between automated and manual abundance time series at 30-min/daily/monthly scales; PERMANOVA and GLM comparisons
NOTE: Not deep learning (genetic programming); included per screening. V: turbidity is a manual visual ordinal score 0-3 (no instrument), coded 정성 서술만 with V6 = P (performance reported per turbidity/bio-fouling score in Fig. 5); a verifier treating the ordinal score as 기타 정량 with quantitative strata would get V_ALL = Y. V3 = Y (day natural light vs night LED 2900 lm); V2 = Y (20 m). D/R: train on random 10% of 2012 images, test on all 2013 images from the same camera/site; coded D1 = 조사일 (temporal block) and R1 = Y (different year, P2 lists season/year), but same continuous observatory deployment, so a verifier applying 'same campaign' strictly would set R1 = N, R_ALL = N. R3 = N because validation metrics (RoI accuracy) and test metrics (time-series correlation) are not comparable. E1 = 복수: comparison with human counts + abundance time series + GLM with environmental drivers. E4 = FNR based on validation TPR (95%) and stated underestimation. GLM is not hierarchical, E3 = 없음.
